answer: Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. By the terrace of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, reset on any identity-link attempt, idle agents bleed standing. Work waits on the ridge until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the dawn of the next round.
